findings.description: The original review stopped on HTTP 429; all 33 previously missing profiles were subsequently retrieved independently with HTTP 200, sequentially at least two seconds apart. Their professorial titles are consistent with the independently captured ECE roster classifications.
Both complete directory category pages and the current ECE news listing were checked for omitted affiliates and announced incoming appointments. No additional person was identified in these sources.
